method.label: Authorized semantic-alignment prompt-improvement variant; not the original baseline
method.declared_change: Generic semantic matching additions only in masked-normalization and leaderboard-normalization system Prompts.
method.prompt_additions_user_reported: Same additions as DeepSeek semantic_alignment_v1; no new design.
method.method_statement_source: User/main handoff; runtime/Prompt integrity audit is outside this utility.
method.evaluation: Unchanged official tdm_eval and leaderboard_eval via byte-identical prior audited evaluator/helpers.
method.tuple_f1: Harmonic mean of official macro P/R; never mean of per-paper F1.
method.LR: Exact normalized TDM hit before numeric conversion.
method.finite_nonempty: At least one finite converted Result for a Gold board.
method.RBO: Official deduplicated numeric-value rankings; not paper IDs.
method.AO: Paper-ID rankings, deterministic paper-ID tie-break, empty boards=0; macro over all27.
method.global_audit: Main task owns global usage/integrity, Prompt and runtime verification, and qualitative examples.
